axes: Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y); asset front = Roblox LookVector (-Z); base on y = 0

assets.name: R_UpperArm
assets.notes: Bone axis = Blender +Z (Roblox +Y, the part UpVector), proximal -> distal; pivot (origin) at the SHOULDER. Blender +Y (Roblox -Z, LookVector) = back of the arm/hand; -Y = palm / inner elbow; thumb side = +X (Roblox +X). Sleeve from the shoulder (z=0) to the elbow (z=0.95); the rounded end past z=0.95 is the elbow ball that covers the joint when the forearm bends (bend the forearm toward -Y). Attachments: Shoulder (origin), Elbow (z=0.95). collide=False, castShadow=False.

assets.name: R_Forearm
assets.notes: Bone axis = Blender +Z (Roblox +Y, the part UpVector), proximal -> distal; pivot (origin) at the ELBOW. Blender +Y (Roblox -Z, LookVector) = back of the arm/hand; -Y = palm / inner elbow; thumb side = +X (Roblox +X). Sleeve from the elbow (z=0) to a rolled cuff (z~0.5-0.6), bare skin to the wrist (z=0.85); the skin continues ~0.075 past the wrist pivot and hides inside the glove cuff of the hand. Attachments: Elbow (origin), Wrist (z=0.85). Skin can be recoloured at runtime to the avatar skin tone. collide=False, castShadow=False.

assets.name: R_HandGrip
assets.notes: Bone axis = Blender +Z (Roblox +Y, the part UpVector), proximal -> distal; pivot (origin) at the WRIST. Blender +Y (Roblox -Z, LookVector) = back of the arm/hand; -Y = palm / inner elbow; thumb side = +X (Roblox +X). Hand closed around a 0.15-stud cylindrical handle (power grip; the Items handles are 0.12-0.17 across). Attachment Grip = centre of the fist on the handle axis: look = handle axis toward the thumb/index side (where a blade-up weapon exits), up = toward the knuckles/fingers (blade edge direction). Weld weapons so their handle axis runs along Grip.look. Fingerless leather glove (Glove) with bare fingers (Skin, can be recoloured to the avatar skin tone) and a brass press stud on the wrist strap. The glove cuff starts at the wrist pivot and sleeves the forearm's wrist end. Attachment Wrist (origin). collide=False, castShadow=False.

assets.name: R_HandOpen
assets.notes: Bone axis = Blender +Z (Roblox +Y, the part UpVector), proximal -> distal; pivot (origin) at the WRIST. Blender +Y (Roblox -Z, LookVector) = back of the arm/hand; -Y = palm / inner elbow; thumb side = +X (Roblox +X). Relaxed open hand (slight natural curl). Attachment Palm = centre of the palm surface, look = out of the palm (-Y), up = toward the fingers. Fingerless leather glove (Glove) with bare fingers (Skin, can be recoloured to the avatar skin tone) and a brass press stud on the wrist strap. The glove cuff starts at the wrist pivot and sleeves the forearm's wrist end. Attachment Wrist (origin). collide=False, castShadow=False.

assets.name: R_HandFist
assets.notes: Bone axis = Blender +Z (Roblox +Y, the part UpVector), proximal -> distal; pivot (origin) at the WRIST. Blender +Y (Roblox -Z, LookVector) = back of the arm/hand; -Y = palm / inner elbow; thumb side = +X (Roblox +X). Punching fist, thumb wrapped over the index/middle fingers. Attachment Knuckles = front of the fist on the striking knuckles, look = punch direction (+Z), up = back of the hand. Fingerless leather glove (Glove) with bare fingers (Skin, can be recoloured to the avatar skin tone) and a brass press stud on the wrist strap. The glove cuff starts at the wrist pivot and sleeves the forearm's wrist end. Attachment Wrist (origin). collide=False, castShadow=False.
